desc:
Welcome to Floppy Archers! 🏹 🎯

UPDATES EVERYDAYYYYYYYY!!!
Latest update: THANKSGIVING UPDATEEE!!! New arrows, bows, kill effects, map, crates, and challenges!!

Currently in BETA, please post feedback and let us know what you like and dont like :)

Wobbly archers, one bow each, and a LOT of flopping. Can you land the perfect shot? 🎯

Drag back to aim, let go to fire ➡️
Land headshots for a KNOCKOUT 💥
Unlock wild arrows with ABILITIES: fire 🔥, lightning ⚡, ice ❄️, balloons 🎈 and more
Open crates for new bows and arrows 📦
Battle 1v1, or team up in 2v2 and 3v3 ⚔️
Level up and earn daily rewards 🏆

LIKE & FAVORITE FOR UPDATES! 👍
